sources.note: Main website. Overview of TCC as full-featured EHR+PM suite. Mentions specialties served, cancer registry connectivity, Bridge partnership, and testimonials from NPs, physicians, and office managers.

ONC mandatory disclosures page. Lists certification criteria, cost components (NewCrop ePrescribing, Medfusion patient portal, API access, Direct messaging as separate costs). States EHI export is PDF or C-CDA format.

Features page. Describes button-based navigation, document management, e-prescribing, health maintenance alerts, voice/handwriting recognition, practice management, scheduling, lab interfaces, reporting suite.
Interoperability page. Describes CDA, HL7, web services for data exchange. Highlights cancer registry reporting with KHIE. Does not specifically mention FHIR or Direct on this page.
EHR overview page. Describes ribbon-based UI, scheduling with eligibility checking, document scanning, reporting with graphs, ICD-10, e-prescribing, SmartCoder, customizable templates.

Practice management page. Detailed billing features: claim filing, payment posting (manual/batch/ERA), financial reporting, Management-by-Exception reports, scheduling features, appointment management.
Capabilities page. Lists clinical documentation, e-prescribing, document management, HIPAA billing, SmartCoder, PQRS, clinical quality dashboard, patient portal, multi-facility connectivity.

FAQ page. Covers supported disciplines (doctors, NPs, PAs, therapists, urgent care), HIPAA compliance, implementation timeline (2-3 months for small practices), training requirements (10-15 hours per person).
ZoomInfo company profile. Reports ~22 employees, ~$1.4M revenue, headquartered in Paducah, KY. Describes TCC as serving solo practitioners, mid-sized clinics, and hospital-based groups.
LeadIQ profile. Similar company size data. Notes 11-50 employees range.
Bridge patient engagement platform. Confirms partnership with UMC for patient portal capabilities including medical records, messaging, appointments, notifications, forms, caregiver management.
MedicalRecords.com listing. Page did not render useful content (JavaScript-heavy).
